objective: Decide packing from a token-length profile and a frozen training configuration without running a GPU probe.

decision_semantics.on: All static gates pass and the request is inside the released enablement domain.
decision_semantics.off: At least one structural or benefit gate fails. Returning packing=false is allowed even outside the enablement domain.
decision_semantics.hold_off: The static features look favorable, but the request is outside the released enablement domain; return packing=false and retain a shadow candidate.

calibration.warning: The ten-point replay is resubstitution evidence, not an independent generalization estimate.

promotion_requirements.full_sft: Keep favorable cases in hold_off until prerelease offline paired experiments cover Full SFT.
promotion_requirements.multimodal: Unsupported; requires a modality-aware packing implementation and independent memory/throughput validation.
promotion_requirements.new_gpu_family: Recalibrate the occupancy gate and validate all positive/negative boundary cases on the new GPU family.
promotion_requirements.new_model_family: Require at least one negative short-sequence boundary and two positive medium/long-sequence cases before automatic enablement.
